args.command: set -o pipefail; echo '=== units ==='; systemctl list-unit-files --type=service --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'openclaw|claw' || true; echo '=== running ==='; ps -ef | grep -Ei '[o]penclaw|18789' || true; echo '=== ports ==='; ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':18789 ' || true; echo '=== binaries ==='; command -v openclaw || true; which openclaw 2>/dev/null || true; ls -l /usr/local/bin/openclaw /usr/bin/openclaw 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== likely config ==='; find /home /var/lib /opt/zen -maxdepth 4 \( -iname '*openclaw*' -o -iname '*claw*' \) -print 2>/dev/null | head -200; echo '=== startup refs ==='; grep -RniE 'openclaw|18789' /etc/systemd/system /etc/cron.d /etc/rc.local /home/*/.config/systemd 2>/dev/null | head -200 || true
